title: Any-acceptance verifier
statement: Given a Boolean-output verifier $M$ and functions $p,k$ from natural numbers to natural numbers, define a verifier on Boolean lists $x,r$ that outputs true exactly when at least one of the first $k(|x|)$ consecutive blocks of $r$, each of length $p(|x|)$, makes $M$ return true on input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ maps pairs of Boolean lists to Booleans
$p$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
$k$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
